title: Pregnancy-Wise Leakage-Controlled Multi-Representation Fusion for Classifying Early- and Later-Recorded Electrohysterographic Recordings Using Wavelet Scalograms
description: Version 1.1.0 provides the verified reviewer-rebuild CLEAN Colab notebook and aggregate outputs for pregnancy-wise, leakage-controlled classification of early- and later-recorded ICEHG DS observations. It corrects the primary mean outer-fold ROC-AUC evaluation, fold-stratified pregnancy-cluster bootstrap, inner three-way prediction protocol, architecture/fusion comparisons, Platt calibration, and added paired, confounder, conventional spectral baseline, CWT sensitivity, repeated-seed, and Grad-CAM analyses. The study is not a validated preterm-birth predictor or clinical diagnostic system. ICEHG DS source observations and large model/signal derivatives are not redistributed.
